intent: Find a single-H100 vLLM serving configuration that minimizes GPU energy per 1,000 output tokens and maximizes output-token throughput while satisfying P95 TTFT <= 1600 ms and P95 TPOT <= 20 ms within a 0.12 GPU-hour online evidence budget, then verify the top two candidates at full fidelity.

protocol.auc_semantics: trapezoidal area normalized by the preregistered budget range
protocol.episode_semantics: candidate-level empirical bootstrap with common random numbers across policies and matched seed ids across budgets
protocol.oracle_semantics: median successful L4 metrics per candidate
